_readme: Every line the ship's diagnostics log shows. Edit freely; restart the game to see changes.
intro: the crash report played once after the failed jump. delay = seconds after the previous line; style = fail (red, bold) / error (red) / ok (green).
auto_issues: problems the ship 'fixes' by itself, drawn at random while stranded.
pilot_issues: problems that need the pilot; the agent asks `question`. {answer} in `outcome` is replaced by what the pilot said (or `default` if nobody answers).
egress_waiver: the issue the game can raise to gate the exit.
wording: the frame around each line. {code}, {id}, {problem}, {fix}, {question}, {how} and {outcome} are filled in.
